evidence.title: ColorSpace - Color Palettes Generator and Color Gradient Tool

name: ColorSpace
summary: Enter a color to generate matching palettes, plus CSS gradient generators for two and three colors.
description: ColorSpace is a browser tool for building color schemes: type in a color and it proposes palettes of matching hues. Separate pages generate CSS linear-gradients from two or three colors and show the copyable CSS code. It is aimed at designers and developers picking colors for a project.
contains: palette generator: enter one color, get matching palettes
CSS gradient generator for two colors
